topics.title: Explore & Perspective
topics.body: Move with [WASD], Sprint with [Shift], Jump with [Space]. Tap [V] anytime to switch between 1st-Person and 3rd-Person.

topics.title: Left & Right-Hand Combat
topics.body: Left Click attacks (hold for heavy Power Attack). Hold Right Click to block with your Shield or cast Left-Hand Spells. Press [1–4] to swap loadouts.

topics.title: Draw & Fire the Bow
topics.body: Hold Left Click to draw your Recurve Bow tight and narrow your aim reticle, then release to loose an arrow.

topics.title: Interactive World Looting
topics.body: Aim at chests, crates, urns, levers, or fallen enemy bodies and press [E] to loot gear and gold.
topics.action_hint: Press [E] on any container or corpse

topics.title: Inventory & Tactical Pause
topics.body: Press [I] or [Tab] to equip weapons/armor and spend Level-Up Attributes & Perks. Opening menus completely freezes the 5-day collapse timer!

topics.title: Safe Room Sanctuary
topics.body: Enemies cannot enter Safe Rooms and immediately flee. Trade with the Vendor [E]. The wall map here has already marked the surrounding area, treasure and champion lairs on your map [M].
topics.action_hint: Trade with the Vendor or study the Area Map [E]

topics.title: Sealed Boss Arena & Vault
topics.body: Crossing the Boss threshold slams the iron portcullis shut! Defeat the Floor Boss to unlock the exit and claim the adjoining Treasure Vault.

topics.title: 5-Day Collapse & Floor Snapshots
topics.body: Each floor collapses after 5 in-game days. Collapse or combat death resets you to your Floor-Entry Snapshot (your pre-floor level & gear). Save & Quit anytime via [Esc].
topics.action_hint: Got it — dismiss or keep exploring

topics.title: Unknown Descent
topics.body: Press [E] on the Hidden Staircase to descend to the next floor. There are no staircase previews — your new Floor-Entry Snapshot locks on arrival!
